name: Inquisitor
description: Skill Proficiencies:. Investigation, Religion Tool Proficiencies:. Thieves' tools, one type of artisan's tools Equipment:. A holy symbol, a set of traveler's clothes, and a belt pouch containing 15 gp Feature: Legal Authority. As an inquisitor of the church, you have the authority to arrest criminals. In the absence of other authorities, you are authorized to pass judgement and even carry out sentencing. If you abuse this power, however, your superiors in the church might strip it from you.
